claimed_root_cause: Abuse throttle identity depends on trusted-proxy and edge-header behavior.
description: Rate-limit client identity uses CF-Connecting-IP/X-Forwarded-For only from a configured trusted proxy peer.

evidence.description: Throttle identity falls back to TCP peer unless proxy trust is established.
Forwarded IP headers are honored only for a trusted immediate peer.
Caddy forwards client identity headers toward the backend.

title: Throttle identity depends on edge header handling
